space: three.js Y-up WORLD transforms (not parent-local): p = position (m), q = quaternion xyzw, s = scale; s product 0 = not spawned (hide)
encoding: each animated component is a uint16 stream of zig-zag-free wrapping deltas: u[0]=d[0], u[i]=(u[i-1]+d[i]) & 0xFFFF; value = lo + u/65535*(hi-lo). Components with {c} are constant. Samples cover frames f0..f1 (inclusive); hold the first/last sample outside. Interpolate linearly between frames (normalise q after nlerp).

threads_morph.apply: position = glb_position + (w(t) - w_bake) * delta  (w(t) = scalar track "<name>:tight"); CPU update of the BufferAttribute, or morphAttributes with influence w(t)-w_bake
threads_morph.space: mesh-local glTF positions (Y-up), vertex order = Draco-decoded order of the GLB primitive (as DRACOLoader returns it)

excluded.stack_nodes: LAYERS stack blocks/lids/cap/spine and their children: driven by stack-explode.json (not duplicated)
